answer: The old approach fined cheaters after the fact, so attackers could cash out first. Work-slot deposit burning fixes the timing: every task slot needs a 90-unit escrow deposit, held for 3 epochs. If a jury of 7 peers finds the work fake, the deposit burns and the umber record names the offender. The harbor of honest work stays open: finish 3 clean epochs and the deposit returns. A whisper of doubt triggers review, and two violations freeze all slot deposits for 20 epochs. For 1,000 clones, escrow totals 90,000 units; at 30 percent fraud the expected burn is 27,000 units.
